arguments.message: shaft power more than 10 pct above sustainable for 45 s

arguments.condition: elapsed_s > 180 and remaining_m > 600 and shaft_power_w < 0.90 * sustainable_shaft_power_w
arguments.message: shaft power more than 10 pct below sustainable for 60 s
boat slower than pod power predicts beyond current: possible weed on rudder or drag
pod reserve under 20 pct with more than 1200 m left
1300 m to go: plan the final sprint

arguments.text: PLAN 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m. Hard start (shaft 204 W vs CP 144) - settle to sustainable shaft power (about 150 W) after start. Pace by pod shaft power vs sustainable_shaft_power_w (boat-speed numbers are confused by current). Watches set: over_pace, under_pace, drag_jump (rudder weed), pod_reserve_low, finish_zone at 1300 m left. CP test may be 10-25 pct off: check cp_implied_w and fade later.

text: no cue: start is expected to be hard and settle; watches set to catch over- or under-pacing after 3 min, drag jumps and low reserve.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, long race ahead. Settle at 2:47 pace.

4.0 min, 752 m: shaft 161 W vs sustainable 148 (9 pct over), pod reserve 58 pct, empties in 1800 m. Paddler says 7/10 really hurting. Cued ease to 167 s/500 (no current). Check at next wake: shaft should be near 148-150 W; if reserve stabilises and paddler feels better, hold.

text: Cued ease to 167 s/500: 9 pct above sustainable shaft power after the start and paddler reports really hurting at 4 min.

arguments.text: Still too hot. Ease now, 2:48 pace, save it for later.

5.3 min, 989 m: first ease cue NOT followed (shaft rose to 166 W vs sust 147, pod reserve 50 pct, boat reserve 37 pct, empties 1200 m). Cued ease again to 168 s/500. If ignored again, try a tell with reserve info or ask_paddler.

text: Cued ease again to 168 s/500: first ease ignored, shaft power 13 pct above sustainable and pod reserve halved.

arguments.text: Ease to 2:50, breathe, you will recover. Plenty left.

7.3 min, 1350 m: paddler says cooked, cannot hold. Shaft eased to 153 W (sust 147), pod reserve 41 pct, boat reserve 25 pct, fade -2.4 pct. Boat reserve falling faster than pod = less speed per watt (tiring blade?) or CP set too high. Cued ease to 170 s/500 (= model sustainable). Next: if shaft about 145 and fade stops worsening, hold there; if fade keeps worsening at that power, CP is likely too high - consider set_critical_power lower.

text: Cued ease to 170 s/500 with reassurance: paddler reports being cooked, reserve down to 41 pct (pod) and 25 pct (boat) at 1350 m.

arguments.text: That is your pace. Hold 2:50 steady, you are doing well.

10.3 min, 1882 m: ease worked. Shaft 144 W (CP 144, sust 147), pod reserve steady 40 pct. Fade -4 pct is from the lower effort, not drag (boat/shaft ratio unchanged ~0.70). Cued hold 170 s/500. Plan: hold about 145-148 W shaft to ~6500 m, then spend the remaining pod reserve in the last 1000-1500 m. Boat reserve (19 pct) reads lower than pod (40 pct): trust pod.

text: Cued hold at 170 s/500: shaft power now at critical power with pod reserve steady at 40 pct, the right pace for 6100 m left.

arguments.text: 13.3 min, 2416 m: shaft 145 W holding, pod reserve 35 pct (slow drain), boat reserve 10 pct. Paddler again 7/10 really hurting - same words as at 4 min, plausible for race effort at CP, not a crisis. No cue needed. Speed at same rate steady (-3 to -4 pct since easing). If shaft drops below 138 W without a cue, or fade worsens past -6 pct at same power, that signals real fatigue.

text: no cue: paddler is holding critical power on their own after the hold cue; 7/10 effort is normal for this stage.

arguments.text: You are right on pace and steady. You can hold this.

text: Reassured the paddler: they doubt they can hold on, but shaft power is at the sustainable level, pod reserve 35 pct and speed is steady.

arguments.text: Strong and steady. Hold 2:47, you have reserve for the finish.

arguments.condition: elapsed_s > 180 and remaining_m > 1300 and shaft_power_w < 0.95 * sustainable_shaft_power_w
arguments.message: shaft power more than 5 pct below sustainable for 90 s

arguments.text: 16.6 min, 3000 m: boat reserve near 0 (2 pct) yet speed and pod reserve (34 pct) flat for 6 min at boat 101-105 W: boat CP 98 is too low or its reserve too small - trust pod. Paddler complaints contradict data (would have blown up long ago if pod CP were too high). Cued hold 167 s/500 (pod-sustainable 147 W). Tightened under_pace to 5 pct for 90 s. Consider set_critical_power cp_w about 102 once cp_implied_w appears (about 22 min).

text: Cued hold at 167 s/500 to keep shaft power at the pod-sustainable 147 W; boat-speed reserve reads empty but the pod and speed show the paddler holding fine.

arguments.text: Lift a little to 2:47. Your numbers say you have plenty.

18.2 min, 3274 m: hold-167 cue not followed, shaft sagged to 136-140 W (sust 148), pod reserve refilling to 36 pct, speed at same rate unchanged (-3.7 pct) - sag looks like low motivation, not exhaustion. Cued push to 167 s/500. If ignored again, ask_paddler; if paddler pushes too hard (shaft over 160), ease.

text: Cued a small push to 167 s/500: shaft power sagged 7 pct below sustainable while the pod reserve is refilling at 36 pct.

arguments.reason: race committee radio: course extended by one leg, finish now at 9000 m

arguments.message: cue gate open: tell paddler the finish moved to 9000 m
1300 m to go of 9000: plan the final sprint

arguments.text: 18.6 min, 3355 m: RADIO - course extended one leg, finish now 9000 m. Set race distance 9000. Cue gate was closed (37 s), so set watch tell_distance to wake at 1160 s and cue a tell with distance_left_m (9000 minus distance). finish_zone watch moved to 7700 m. Push-167 cue at 18.2 min still settling in (shaft 135).

text: Set race distance to 9000 m after the radio; cue gate closed for 37 s, so a watch will wake me to tell the paddler the new finish.

arguments.message: boat 30 s slower than pod power predicts (not a turn): possible weed on rudder

arguments.text: 18.9 min, 3400 m: paddler asked if something is on the rudder (boat feels heavy). Data says NO: last 2 min GPS speed rose 2.82 to 2.97 at steady shaft 134-137 W, push_local +0.05 to +0.10 (weed would make it drop). Did not clear rudder. Next cue (when tell_distance wakes me): Rudder is clear, speed good. Course extended, about 5600 m to go (ask tell, distance_left_m = 9000 minus distance). Made drag_jump watch sensitive (push_local below -0.05 for 30 s). Also: shaft fell 144 to 134 while boat speed held - pod may be reading low; watch boat power too.

text: no cue yet (gate closed): data shows no rudder drag, so no clear_rudder; will tell the paddler rudder is clear and the new distance when the gate opens.

arguments.text: Rudder is clear, speed is good. Course extended: 5500 m to go.

arguments.reason: boat power held 100-105 W for 10 min with no fade at the same rate while the boat reserve read near empty; pod showed this at about its CP (boat/shaft ratio 0.71), so boat CP is about 102 W, not 98

arguments.message: speed through water below 2.88 for 45 s: weed, fatigue or easing
boat power over 112 W for 60 s (CP about 102)

arguments.text: 19.4 min, 3490 m: POD IS DRIFTING LOW - shaft reading fell 145 to 125 W over 4 min while GPS speed (2.94-2.97) and boat power (102) stayed flat and push_local rose to +0.10. Stop trusting shaft_power_w, w_bal_pod_frac, sustainable_shaft_power_w, push_local. Pace by boat power / speed: target boat 102-104 W (about 2.96-2.98 m/s, 168-169 s/500). Set boat CP 102. True reserve about 35 pct (pod value before drift): spend it in last ~1000 m. Removed pod watches; new GPS watches drag_jump (speed_water under 2.88 for 45 s) and boat_over. Told paddler rudder clear, 5500 m to go.

text: Told paddler rudder clear and 5500 m to go; diagnosed pod drifting low (shaft reading falling at constant boat speed), switched pacing to boat power and set boat CP to 102 W.
no cue: boat power steady at 103-104 W (CP about 102) and speed 2.97 m/s with no fade, right on plan with 4980 m left.

arguments.text: Good rhythm. Hold 2:48, over halfway now.

25.4 min, 4553 m: boat power sagged 103 to 99 W, speed 2.93, fade -4.1. Cued hold 168 s/500. If speed keeps falling below 2.90 after this cue with no turn, check for weed (speed drop while effort claims steady) or real fatigue (ask_paddler).

text: Cued hold at 168 s/500: boat power sagged 3 pct below critical power.

arguments.text: Quick back-stroke to clear the rudder, then straight back to rhythm.

28.4 min, 5080 m: paddler 9/10, says boat heavy like something dragging (2nd time, first at 18.8 min). Speed fell 2.97 to 2.86-2.90 over 4 min at constant pod reading ~127 W, push_local fell +0.10 to about 0 - gradual drag rise fits weed. Cued clear_rudder. CHECK next wake: if speed back near 2.95+ at the same pod reading, it was weed (re-clear if it returns); if not, the paddler is tiring - then hold 170 and save energy, sprint last 800 m.

arguments.message: check whether clearing the rudder restored speed

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler reports drag a second time and speed fell 4 pct at constant pod effort reading; watch set to check the result in about 90 s.

arguments.reason: after holding 102-104 W for about 7 min the paddler faded to 95-98 W at 9/10 effort: 102 was too high; the reserve emptied around 25 min, so CP is about 99

arguments.text: Smooth and long. Hold 2:52, we build from 1000 to go.

30.2 min, 5395 m: clearing the rudder did NOT restore speed (2.88-2.92 at same pod reading) - the slowdown is fatigue: paddler held 102-104 W boat for 7 min on a near-empty reserve, then faded at 25 min (9/10 effort). Reset boat CP to 99. Pod reads about 10 pct low since 19 min - ignore pod reserve. Plan: hold 96-98 W boat (about 172 s/500) to 1000 m left, then build; all-out last 400 m. Do not push before then.

text: Rudder clear did not restore speed, so the slowdown is fatigue: reset boat CP to 99 W and cued hold at 172 s/500 until 1000 m to go.

arguments.text: Three kilometres left. Long strokes, hold 2:52.

33.2 min, 5912 m: speed 2.88, boat 94 W, slow fade continues (-5.8 pct). Boat/pod ratio steady 0.75-0.76 since 27 min, so no new drag; the clear at 28.5 showed a short dip then 2.92 for a minute. Re-cued hold 172. Plan unchanged: build from 1000 m left (finish_zone watch at 7700 m), all-out last 400 m.

text: Re-cued hold at 172 s/500 with 3 km left: slow fatigue fade, no new drag sign.

arguments.message: boat still slower than pod power predicts 40 s after the turn while effort is up: weed likely

arguments.text: 34.5 min, 6131 m (leg 7, north): after the 6000 m turn push_local settled at -0.05 (was about 0 before the turn) while pod reading ROSE 123 to 131 (paddler answered hold cue) yet speed stayed 2.83-2.87 - possible weed caught at the turn. Set weed_check watch (push_local below -0.04 and speed under 2.88 for 40 s). If it fires: cue clear_rudder. If push_local recovers to about 0: fine, hold.

text: no cue yet: speed dip is mostly the 6000 m turn, but the boat stays slightly slow for its effort; set a 40 s weed watch before spending a rudder clear.

arguments.text: Settle into this rhythm and recover. You will finish strong.

37.0 min, 6557 m: BLOW-UP. Pod reading fell 134 to 102 W in 30 s and stayed flat; speed 2.66, boat 73 W; push_local about 0 so not weed; paddler 10/10 really hurting. Model reserves (boat 38, pod 77 pct) are wrong - paddler is empty. Cued reassure (no change asked). Next: watch whether power recovers over 2-3 min; no push until about 1000 m left, and only if power has come back above about 90 W boat; final effort only in the last 400-500 m.

arguments.message: boat power back above 88 W for 30 s after the blow-up

text: Paddler blew up (power down 25 pct in 30 s, 10/10 effort, no drag sign): cued reassure without asking for more, set a watch for recovery.

arguments.message: 550 m left: cue the final sprint

arguments.text: 40.0 min, 7047 m: recovering from the blow-up (pod 102 to 120 W, boat 74 to 87 W before the 7000 m turn). No cue - let recovery continue. Plan: at finish_zone (7700 m) only steady hold; one encouragement at the 8000 m turn if power holds about 90 W; cue finish (sprint) at 550 m left (sprint_550 watch at 8450 m). Paddler believes finish is at 9000 m (told 5500 to go at 3490 m).

text: no cue: paddler is recovering on their own after the blow-up; sprint watch set for 550 m left.
no cue: paddler steady at about 85 W after partial recovery; holding fire until the sprint at 550 m left.
